
  ▲ vercel env remove name [options]

  Remove an Environment Variable (see examples below)                           

  Options:

  -e,  --environment <ENVIRONMENT>  Remove the variable from this environment   
                                    only. Without it, the variable is removed   
                                    from all of its environments                
       --git-branch <BRANCH>        Remove the variable for this Git branch only
       --project <NAME_OR_ID>       Project name or ID (default: linked project)
  -y,  --yes                        Skip the confirmation prompt when removing  
                                    an Environment Variable                     


  Global Options:

       --cwd <DIR>            Sets the current working directory for a single   
                              run of a command                                  
  -d,  --debug                Debug mode (default: off)                         
  -Q,  --global-config <DIR>  Path to the global `.vercel` directory            
  -h,  --help                 Output usage information                          
  -A,  --local-config <FILE>  Path to the local `vercel.json` file              
       --no-color             No color mode (default: off)                      
       --non-interactive      Run without interactive prompts (default: on when 
                              an agent is detected)                             
  -S,  --scope                Set a custom scope                                
  -t,  --token <TOKEN>        Login token                                       
  -v,  --version              Output the version number                         


  Examples:

  - Remove a variable from multiple Environments

    $ vercel env remove <name>
    $ vercel env remove API_TOKEN

  - Remove a variable from a specific Environment

    $ vercel env remove <name> --environment <production | preview | development>
    $ vercel env remove NPM_RC --environment preview

  - Remove a variable from a specific Environment and Git Branch

    $ vercel env remove <name> --environment <production | preview | development> --git-branch <BRANCH>
    $ vercel env remove NPM_RC --environment preview --git-branch feat1
